title: Weapon Script
content:
Extends: Form Script
Editor: Weapon Script for the manipulation of weapon base objects. Definition: ScriptName Weapon extends Form Native Hidden Properties: None Global Functions: None Member Functions: - Function Fire(ObjectReference akSource, Ammo akAmmo) Fires this weapon from the specified source object. - Ammo Function GetAmmo() Gets the ammo used by this weapon. F4SE Member Functions: - ObjectMod Function GetEmbeddedMod() Gets this weapon's embedded mod. - Owner Function GetInstanceOwner() Gets this weapon's InstanceData owner. - Function SetEmbeddedMod(ObjectMod akMod) Sets this weapon's embedded mod. Events: None
